Go AST Inspector: standalone Go AST extractor/browser visualizer; single HTML distribution. Stack: TypeScript 5.x strict, Svelte 5.x runes, Vite 5.x, Biome 1.x, Go WebAssembly; UI English. Packages: go/ast, go/parser, go/token. Method: Svelte Writable Store. Stores: `astStore`, `parseErrorStore`, `selectedNodeStore`, `expandedNodesStore`.

Before working: read `REQUIREMENTS.md`, then `DESIGN.md`; requirements override design. Do not implement based on independent judgment; ask user if undocumented. Report contradictions to user and request confirmation. Follow architecture, directory, data flow, and build configuration in DESIGN.md; check package.json and analyze error messages.

Enable strict mode; explicitly type definitions and props; avoid magic numbers; use constants; use `$state`, `$derived`, `$effect`; single-responsibility components; BEM recommended; global styles in `src/styles/global.css`, component styles in `<style>`.

MUST convention: Prohibit redundant comments (no explanation needed for simple operations)
SHOULD convention: Write comments where code intent is hard to convey
MUST convention: Write commit messages in English
MUST convention: Write Pull Request titles and descriptions in English
MUST convention: Add GPG sign to all commits
MUST convention: Add Claude as Co-Author:
🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
Co-Authored-By: Claude <<REDACTED_EMAIL>>
MUST convention: Run `npm run lint` before committing
MUST convention: Run `npm run type-check` before committing
If either command exits with an error, fix the issues before committing
Lint errors: Run `npm run format` to auto-fix formatting issues
Type errors: Fix type mismatches in the reported files

Use vite-plugin-singlefile; inline all JS/CSS/WASM binaries. Go AST only; use go/parser.
